title: 第一章 富婆快乐琴
content_zh:
“姓名？”
“槐诗。”
“年龄呢？”
“十七。”
“十七？”
面试的男人挑起了眉头，看向了桌子前面的少年，那个背着沉重琴箱的消瘦少年赶忙露出了讨好的笑容。
他穿着有些旧的礼服，脸色有些苍白，好像许久不见阳光，头发略微凌乱，但一双漆黑的眼瞳却好像被蜡烛照着一样，亮得有些吓人。
“哥特系啊？真少见，现在不少人都好这口儿……”
主持面试的男人莫名其妙地嘟哝了一句，审视着少年，语气严肃起来：“我说小槐啊，你要知道，我们俱乐部走得可是精英化路线，不是什么阿猫阿狗都能来的。”
“精英，精英！我懂！”
槐诗挺直小身板儿，用力点头，十足地狗腿：“来之前老杨都交代过我的，您这儿要求严格，您放心，我经验丰富！”
说罢，还挤出了一个堪称谄媚地笑容。
要求虽然严格，但钱也给的多啊！
这年头经济又萧条得不行，最近新海大笔大笔的人失业，一个穷学生能找个拉琴的兼职天知道有多难，槐诗都已经快要穷到倒毙，听中介老杨说给他找了份油水丰厚的活儿，他都快高兴疯了。
真要让这活儿从指头缝里溜走了，是要天打雷劈的！
来之前听老杨说，这里可是针对富豪们经营的会员制俱乐部，光是里面端盘子的服务员都能拿个几千块的小费，能在这里拉琴，还怕赚不到钱？
好像诧异与他那莫名其妙的诚心，面试官也愣了一下，微微颔首：“行了，面试表上说你还会大提琴，表演一个吧，可别太水。”
“这您就放心吧！”
槐诗信心百倍地坐下来律便自弦之上流淌而出。
要说其他的他可能会害怕，但要是看大提琴的话，他可没怂过，从小奖状都拿到手软，要不是请不起名师，现在他说不定早就去国际大赛上抛头露面了。

这一首不知道练过多少次的海c，哪怕放到专业评审那里去都挑不出任何错处。一旦开始拉琴，他的心情就顿时平静了下来，发挥竟然比往常还要更好，灵动音符之间那深重的惆怅简直呼之欲出。
只不过在短短几分钟之后，面试官就有些厌倦地挥了挥手：“行了，就到这儿吧。”
“啊？”
槐诗愕然抬头，不知道自己哪里出了错儿，赶忙翻起背包：“我还有专业证书，英皇八级，要不够的话，下个月我还要考专业初级……”
“行了，别整那些花里胡哨的。”
面试官不耐烦地摇头，“我们这里不看重学历，琴拉得凑合有个噱头就行了，主要得看你的本事……”
说着，他弯腰从抽屉里拿出了几个东西放在桌子上，排成一排，指了指：“你会哪个？”
“啥？”
槐诗傻眼，看着桌子上的那几个玩意儿，一头雾水：
“这……是什么乐器？”
“哎，我说你究竟懂不懂啊？你不是说你从业经验丰富的吗？”
面试官不快地指着桌子上的钢丝球、铁钉和煤气喷罐以及核桃夹子介绍道：“富婆快乐球，富婆快乐钉，富婆快乐火、富婆快乐钳……你会哪个？”
“……”
槐诗沉吟了许久，看了看怀里的大提琴，抱着最后一线希望地问道：“富婆快乐……琴？”
老板，有金手指成么？
或者用你们的行话，叫‘富婆快乐指’？
“合着就是什么都不会咯？”
面试官大怒，指着他的鼻子怒斥：“你知不知道我工作有多忙？什么都不会就跑来做牛郎？我可是推了好几个约来面试的，这不是浪费我时间么？”
“……你们这里不是餐厅招乐手么？”
直到现在，一脸懵逼的槐诗才发现：自己似乎又被傻屌中介坑了……诶？为什么要说又呢？

“等一下！”
他严肃地抬起手：“先生，我可是卖艺不卖身的！”
办公室的门在身后关上了。
被赶出办公室的槐诗坐在走廊的椅子上，后怕的要命，感觉自己刚刚距离半生清白丧尽只有一步之遥，可看了一眼自己存款余额之后，又忍不住跃跃欲试地想要把那一步跨出去……
艺都卖了这么多年了，还差卖个身么？
反正关了灯都一样，最后还是自己爽……只要给钱爽快一些，似乎不是不可以接受啊。
就在他捏着下巴沉吟的时候，脑子里又窜出来刚刚那一堆’富婆快乐系列产品’，顿时浑身打哆嗦。
这一刻，槐诗深刻地意识到：这世界上的快乐是守恒的。意思就是说，如果富婆快乐的狠了，自己后半辈子可能就再也快乐不起来了。
还是算了吧，算了吧……
他含着眼泪拒绝了来自金钱的诱惑，一步三回头地走出了俱乐部门外，看着门口包了一层金色的石狮子，又忍不住想要回头再回去。
“等等！”
身后忽然有人喊住他，是个穿着礼服的男人，面容俊秀而肃冷，扫着他的眼神充满了苛刻，“喂，你！站住！”
“我？”
槐诗有些心慌，在他的逼视之下忍不住后仰了一些。
“你就是今天那个新来的？连会所的一哥都不拜见就走了，懂不懂规矩？”那男人走在他前面，站在台阶上居高临下地看着他，点了点头：“脸还算不错，不过最好还是安分一点，论美貌，你是比不过我的。”
说着，他风骚地抬手梳理了一下自己的漂了几缕金色的长发，弄得槐诗心里一阵腻歪，恼火地回应：“抱歉，一哥，我不做牛郎！”
“哦，现在叫男公关了，都一样。”
‘一哥’了然地点头，大度地挥手说道：“没关系，既然叫我一声一哥，那以后就由我罩着你。”
说着，从手包里掏出了一个瓶子塞进槐诗怀里，语重心长地拍了拍他的肩膀：“做牛郎也要专业，回去给我把脸上的油去了，你护肤保养太糙了，可惜了这张小脸……省着点用啊，这可是欧洲的高档货。”
说完，不等槐诗’谢恩’，他一抬下巴，转身走了。

“……”
槐诗目瞪口呆地站在门口，低头看着手里的化妆品，不知道究竟应不应该把这玩意儿摔门口喊一声三十年河面三十年河底，莫欺少年穷之类的话。
许久，他看了看那个精致地小瓶子，有些牙疼地塞进了怀里。
算了，来都来了，看上去还挺贵的，丢了怪可惜……还没开封呢，回头让老杨拿了卖了去。
贫穷使我谦虚。
为什么自己明明有金手指还真么贫穷啊！
他翻出了背包里那一本笔记，翻来覆去地看了半通，长叹一声，又塞进了兜里。
想到老杨，他又忍不住恨得咬牙，拿出手机拨通号码，一顿大骂：“老杨你特么有病吧？好端端地你介绍我去面试做牛郎！你是想赚中介费想赚疯了吧？”
“哎，这不是没问清楚嘛，人家那儿要求年轻从业经验丰富，长得要好看，还要有才艺的……哥哥想到你这么穷，不也是为你着想么？别生气，后天请你吃饭怎么样？庆祝你嫂子最近出院，你记得提点韭菜过来……”
“提个屁你吃不吃？”
槐诗没好气儿地挂断了电话，这王八蛋绝对是故意的，就指着自己不小心上贼船之后给他的那一笔中介费呢。
但想到老杨家里的情况，又恨不起来。
这孙子为了给自己得了癌症的老婆凑医药费，赚起钱来简直不要命，要不然也不会连槐诗这种兼职的零碎生意都做，就为了中间那么几十块的抽成……况且除了中介费不打折扣之外，这家伙还算厚道，没有巧立名目再抠他什么钱。
大家也算难兄难弟。
算了算了……
槐诗叹了口气，听见了雷声。
阴沉的天空之上，远方飘来了漆黑的云，在黯淡阳光的照耀之下，隐约可以看到生长在云层之间的珊瑚群，还有鱼群游曳的影子……
带着些微蓝色的海洋轻轻动荡着，向大地洒下一片涟漪的光。
要下雨了。
据说在七八十年前的，这种珊瑚云还不多见，那时候它们还都在海里，没飘到天上全世界乱飞。

不少科学家说是什么稀有元素的发现还是大气污染的原因，但没多少人信。
一开始的时候，大家都慌得一批，觉得末世要来了，可等了几十年，也没等到丧尸这种经典末世物种。
时间长了，大家就习惯了。
只不过就是天上多了个东西飘着，无非就是多下了点雨嘛，飞机换个航线不也照样继续飞么？
钱还得赚，债还要还，日子也还得照样过。
乱了几天之后，一切又恢复了正常。
似乎和之前的日子没什么区别。
雷声阵阵。
槐诗没带伞，不敢浪费时间，转身狂奔着回家，只是在狂奔之中，他又听见了远方传来的巨响。
这一次的雷声格外的清晰，就连大地都颤抖了起来。
他顺着声音传来的方向抬头，便看到远处的码头升起了一团烟雾和火光，好像是有什么东西爆炸了。
街头的行人们彼此对视着，神情茫然，有人兴奋地拿出手机在拍，还有人兴奋地往过靠拢，想蹭点热闹看看。
要是在往常，槐诗说不定也要过去看个稀奇，可现在他感觉自己快要被生活和牛郎的双重重担压垮脊梁，热闹什么的，还是算了吧……
他叹了口气，前面左拐走进小巷子里，加快速度。
小巷子的尽头，有个瓶子被踢到了墙上，玻璃茬撒了一地，紧接着，又被一只皮靴踩碎了。
有人从旁边的拐角里冲出来，像是喝醉了一样，脚步踉跄，甚至没有减缓速度，擦着槐诗，bia一下，整个人都糊在了墙上。
槐诗愣住了。
这是什么好汉？
却没想到，那个’好汉’在撞击中踉跄后退，看到槐诗之后，便猛然扑了过来。
槐诗躲闪不及，被他抓住了手腕，紧接着，感觉到一个沉重的箱子塞进了自己的怀里。

“啥玩意儿？”
他愣在原地，本能地想要抽手，却感觉到手上湿湿的，粘稠的红色从那个人的袖子里流出来。
直到现在，浓厚到化不开的血腥味才扑面而来。
槐诗骤然感觉到一阵剧烈的眩晕和头疼，弯下腰，不由自主地干呕出了一堆口水。
当他抬起头的时候，终于看到那个人狰狞的面孔，还有扭曲在一起的五官。他愕然地看着槐诗，好像要说什么，却张口吐出了一大口血。
明明场景如此诡异，可槐诗却不小心看到，地上那一滩他吐出来的血里……有一条小金鱼?
甚至算不上大，就是那种一般人养在鱼缸里的观赏用金鱼品种，看上去肥肥胖胖的，分外可爱。
“哥们你口儿真重啊，这能吃吗？还是生的！”
槐诗目瞪口呆：“怕不是肚子吃坏了？”
可紧接着，他便看到那一只在血泊里扑腾的金鱼迅速地干瘪下去，到最后变成一团灰一样的东西，融化在了血中。
随着金鱼的死去，那个人好像也失去了所有的力气，倒在了地上，没有了呼吸。只有浓厚的血色从风衣下面渗出来。
寂静里，小巷中只剩下了槐诗。
还有那个被塞进他手中的盒子……
那个盒子看上去比普通的魔方要大一些，入手沉甸甸的，摇晃一下，里面好像装满了液体。
摸起来有种铁和铜独有的冰凉质感，表面还雕刻着槐诗未曾见过的华丽图腾，只不过这些图腾都被那个人粘稠的血覆盖了，看不清，可是好像有不可思议的魔力。
槐诗吞了口吐沫。
感觉到了干渴。
只是只是将它捧在手中，便忍不住想要有，想要得到……
他深吸了一口气。
这种情况下究竟怎么选，难道还用得着去想么？

槐诗不假思索，掏出了电话。
“喂？110吗？”
content_en:
"Name?"
"Sophora poems."
"What about your age?"
"Seventeen."
"Seventeen?"
The interviewing man raised his eyebrows and looked at the young man in front of the table. The thin young man carrying a heavy piano case quickly showed a flattering smile.
He was wearing an old dress, and his face was a little pale, as if he hadn't seen the sun for a long time. His hair was a little messy, but his dark eyes seemed to be illuminated by candles, which were frighteningly bright.
"Gothic type? It's really rare. Many people like this nowadays..."
The man hosting the interview muttered something incomprehensible, looked at the young man, and his tone became serious: "I'm talking about Xiaohuai, you have to know that our club is an elite club, and not just any cat or dog can join."
"Elite, elite! I understand!"
Huai Shi straightened her little body, nodded vigorously, and said in a dog-like manner: "Old Yang told me before I came here, you are strict here, don't worry, I have rich experience!"
After saying that, he forced out a smile that could be described as flattering.
Although the requirements are strict, the money is generous!
The economy is extremely depressed these days, and a lot of people in Xinhai have lost their jobs recently. God knows how difficult it is for a poor student to find a part-time job playing the piano. Huaishi is almost dying of poverty. Hearing that the agency Lao Yang said that he found a lucrative job for him, he almost went crazy with joy.
It would take a thunderbolt to let this job slip through my fingers!
Before coming here, I heard Lao Yang say that this is a members-only club run by the rich. The waiters who serve dishes can get tips of several thousand yuan. If you can play the piano here, are you afraid that you won't make any money?
As if surprised by his inexplicable sincerity, the interviewer was stunned for a moment and nodded slightly: "Okay, the interview form said that you can also play the cello, give it a performance, but don't be too cool."
"Don't worry about that!"
Huaishi sat down confidently and the rhythm flowed out from the strings.
He might be afraid of other things, but when it comes to the cello, he has never been timid. He even received small awards and was weak. If he couldn't afford to hire a famous teacher, he might have gone to the international competition to show his face by now.
I don’t know how many times I have practiced this song, but even if it was submitted to a professional reviewer, I would not be able to find anything wrong with it. Once he started playing the piano, his mood suddenly calmed down, and his performance was even better than usual. The deep melancholy between the smart notes was almost ready to come out.
But after just a few minutes, the interviewer waved his hand with some boredom: "Okay, let's stop here."
"Huh?"
Huai Shi raised her head in shock, not knowing what she had done wrong, and hurriedly picked up her backpack: "I still have a professional certificate, King's Level 8. If it's not enough, I will take the junior professional exam next month..."
"Okay, don't do all the bells and whistles."
The interviewer shook his head impatiently, "We don't value academic qualifications here. Just have a gimmick to pull it off. It mainly depends on your ability..."
As he spoke, he bent down and took out a few things from the drawer, placed them on the table, lined them up in a row, and pointed: "Which one do you know?"
"What?"
Huai Shi was dumbfounded and looked at the things on the table, confused:
"What...is this instrument?"
"Hey, let me ask you, do you understand? Didn't you say that you have rich experience in the industry?"
The interviewer pointed unhappily at the steel wire balls, nails, gas spray cans and walnut crackers on the table and introduced: "Rich woman is happy with balls, rich woman is happy with nails, rich woman is happy with fire, rich woman is happy with pliers...which one do you know?"
"..."
Huai Shi pondered for a long time, looked at the cello in her arms, and asked with the last glimmer of hope: "Happy rich woman... Qin?"
Boss, do you have a golden finger?
Or in your jargon, it’s called ‘rich woman’s happy finger’?
"Doesn't it mean you can't do anything when co-writing?"
The interviewer was furious, pointing at his nose and yelling: "Do you know how busy I am at work? You don't know anything and you become a cowherd? I made several appointments for interviews. Isn’t this a waste of my time? "
“…Aren’t you the restaurant’s waiter here? "
It was only now that the confused Huai Shi realized that she seemed to have been tricked by a stupid agency again...Eh? Why say it again?
"Wait a minute! "
He raised his hand seriously: "Sir, I'm not a prostitute! "
The office door closed behind him.
Huai Shi, who was kicked out of the office, sat on a chair in the corridor, terrified to death. She felt that she was just one step away from losing her innocence for half her life. But after taking a look at her balance, she couldn't help but eager to take that step...
After selling your art for so many years, do you still need to sell your body?
Anyway, it's the same even if the lights are turned off. In the end, I feel happy... As long as I feel more comfortable giving money, it doesn't seem unacceptable.
Just as he was holding his chin and thinking deeply, the pile of 'Rich Woman's Happy Series Products' came into his mind again, and he suddenly trembled all over.
At this moment, Huai Shi realized deeply: happiness in this world is conserved. This means that if the rich woman is too happy, she may never be happy again for the rest of her life.
Just forget it, forget it...
With tears in his eyes, he rejected the temptation of money and walked out of the club with three steps. Looking at the golden stone lion covering the door, he couldn't help but want to turn back.
"Wait! "
Suddenly, someone called him from behind. It was a man in a formal dress, with a handsome and solemn face. His eyes that glanced at him were full of harshness, "Hey, you! stop! "
"I? "
Huai Shi was a little flustered and couldn't help but lean back a little under his gaze.
"Are you the new one today? He left without even meeting the first brother in the club. Do you understand the rules? "The man walked in front of him, stood on the steps and looked at him condescendingly, and nodded: "You have a pretty good face, but it's better to be calm. In terms of beauty, you can't compare to me. "
As he spoke, he coquettishly raised his hand to comb his long blonde hair, which made Huai Shi feel disgusted and responded angrily: "Sorry, Brother Yi, I don't want to be a cowherd! "
"Oh, now I call the male publicist, it's the same. "
‘Brother One’ nodded in understanding, waved his hand magnanimously and said, “It doesn’t matter, since you call me Brother One, I will protect you from now on. "
With that said, he took out a bottle from his handbag and stuffed it into Huai Shi's arms. He patted his shoulder earnestly and said, "Being a cowherd requires professionalism. Go back and remove the oil on your face. Your skin care regimen is too rough. It's a pity for this little face... Save it. This is a high-end European product." "
After saying that, without waiting for Huai Shi to say thank you, he raised his chin, turned around and left.
"..."
Huai Shi stood dumbfounded at the door, looking down at the cosmetics in her hand. She didn't know whether she should throw this thing at the door and shout: "Thirty years on the surface of the river, thirty years on the bottom of the river. Don't bully young people into poverty."
For a long time, he looked at the delicate little bottle and stuffed it into his arms with some toothache.
Forget it, it's here, it looks quite expensive, it's a pity to lose it...it hasn't been opened yet, so I asked Lao Yang to take it and sell it later.
Poverty makes me humble.
Why am I so poor even though I have a golden finger?
He dug out the notebook in his backpack, flipped through it half-way through, sighed, and stuffed it into his pocket again.
Thinking of Lao Yang, he couldn't help but grit his teeth with hatred, took out his mobile phone and dialed the number, and cursed: "Lao Yang, are you really sick? You kindly introduced me to the interview to be a Cowherd! Are you going crazy trying to earn agency fees? "
"Hey, I didn't ask clearly. They require young people with rich experience in the industry, good looks, and talents... Brother, thinking that you are so poor,Isn’t it also for your sake? Don't be angry. How about I treat you to dinner the day after tomorrow? To celebrate your sister-in-law’s recent discharge from the hospital, please remember to bring some leeks..."
"Stop talking, do you want to eat it? "
Huai Shi hung up the phone angrily. This bastard definitely did it on purpose. He was pointing at the agency fee she gave him after he accidentally boarded the pirate ship.
But when I think about the situation in Lao Yang's family, I can't feel any hatred.
In order to collect the medical expenses for his wife who has cancer, this grandson is desperate to make money. Otherwise, he would not even do a part-time business like Huaishi, just for the commission of dozens of dollars... Besides, except for the agency fee, this guy is quite kind and does not use any clever excuses to make money from him.
We can all be considered brothers in distress.
Forget it, forget it...
Huai Shi sighed and heard thunder.
Above the gloomy sky, dark clouds floated in the distance. Under the dim sunlight, you could vaguely see the coral groups growing between the clouds, as well as the shadows of fish swimming...
The slightly blue ocean is gently turbulent, spreading ripples of light to the earth.
It's going to rain.
It is said that seventy or eighty years ago, such coral clouds were rare. At that time, they were still in the sea and did not float into the sky and fly around the world.
Many scientists say that the discovery of some rare element or the cause of air pollution, but not many people believe it.
At the beginning, everyone was panicking, thinking that the end of the world was coming, but after waiting for decades, zombies, a classic apocalyptic species, were not seen.
Over time, everyone will get used to it.
It’s just that there’s something floating in the sky, it’s just raining a little more. Wouldn’t the plane continue flying if it changes its route?
Money has to be earned, debts have to be repaid, and life has to go on as usual.
After a few days of chaos, everything returned to normal.
It seems no different from the previous days.
Thunder bursts.
Huaishi didn't bring an umbrella and didn't dare to waste time. He turned around and ran home. But while running, he heard a loud noise in the distance again.
This time the thunder was so clear that even the ground trembled.
He looked up in the direction of the sound and saw a cloud of smoke and fire rising from the dock in the distance, as if something had exploded.
Pedestrians on the street looked at each other with confused expressions. Some people excitedly took out their mobile phones to take pictures, while others moved closer excitedly, wanting to take part in the excitement.
In normal times, Huaishi might have gone over to see the strange things, but now he feels that his back is about to be crushed by the double burden of life and Cowherd. Let's forget about the excitement...
He sighed, turned left into the alley, and speeded up.
At the end of the alley, a bottle was kicked against the wall, and glass stubble was scattered on the floor. Then, it was crushed by a leather boot.
Someone rushed out from the corner next to him, staggering as if he was drunk, without even slowing down. He brushed against the Sophora japonica and bialy, and his whole body was stuck to the wall.
Huai Shi was stunned.
What kind of hero is this?
Unexpectedly, the 'hero' staggered back from the impact, and when he saw Huai Shi, he suddenly rushed over.
Huai Shi couldn't dodge and was grabbed by his wrist. Then, she felt a heavy box being stuffed into her arms.
"What the hell? "
He froze in place and instinctively wanted to pull his hand away, but he felt his hands were wet and sticky red flowed from the man's sleeves.
It was only now that the overwhelming smell of blood hit his face.
Huai Shi suddenly felt a severe dizziness and headache. She bent down and involuntarily retched and spit out a lot of saliva.
When he raised his head, he finally saw the man's ferocious face and his twisted facial features. He looked at Huai Shi in astonishment, as if he was about to say something, but he opened his mouth and spit out a large mouthful of blood.
The scene is obviously so weird, but HuaishiBut he accidentally saw that in the puddle of blood he spit out on the ground... there was a little goldfish?
It's not even big, it's the kind of ornamental goldfish that most people keep in fish tanks. It looks plump and very cute.
"Brother, you are so mouthy. Can this be eaten? It's still raw!"
Huai Shi was dumbfounded: "Isn't it because you have a bad stomach?"
But then, he saw that the goldfish flapping in the pool of blood quickly shriveled up, and finally turned into a ball of gray that melted into the blood.
As the goldfish died, the man seemed to have lost all his strength and fell to the ground, no longer breathing. Only thick blood seeped out from under the windbreaker.
In the silence, only Huai Shi remained in the alley.
And the box that was thrust into his hand...
The box looked larger than an ordinary Rubik's Cube, and it was heavy in hand. When shaken, it seemed to be filled with liquid.
It has a unique cold texture of iron and copper to the touch, and the surface is engraved with gorgeous totems that Huaishi has never seen before. However, these totems are covered with the man's sticky blood and cannot be seen clearly, but they seem to have incredible magical power.
Huai Shi swallowed and spat.
Feeling thirsty.
Just holding it in my hands, I can't help but want to have it, want to get it...
He took a deep breath.
Is it even necessary to think about how to choose in this situation?
Huaishi took out the phone without thinking.
"Hello? 110?"
